title: The Weatherbound Oath
premise: Apprentice stormbinder Iona Vale inherits a travelling court that settles disputes between villages and their weather spirits. Each broken pact sends her to a new province, where repairing the seasons reveals another clause in an ancient bargain. Across four books, she must unite rival spirits before the crown turns the climate into a weapon.
cover_prompt: Painterly epic fantasy illustration: a lone young stormbinder in a copper cloak on a stone causeway, holding a glowing glass weather vane; immense spiralling clouds above terraced villages. Palette of midnight indigo, oxidised copper and lightning gold. Strong silhouette, luminous atmosphere and a dark upper third for the integrated title.

title: Love at Juniper Landing
premise: Landscape architect Mara Quinn returns to rescue her family's riverside cabins and must share the renovation with Theo, the boatbuilder whose proposal she once refused. As each cabin welcomes a new neighbour, three interconnected romances unfold through flood season, a summer festival and a winter wedding, while Mara and Theo learn to build a home without surrendering their dreams.
cover_prompt: Contemporary illustrated romance cover art: two adults on opposite ends of a half-restored wooden jetty, a woman with garden plans and a man carrying an oar, inviting riverside cabins and juniper trees behind them. Coral pink, sage green and warm cream palette, golden summer light and playful clean shapes with integrated romantic typography.

title: The Blackout Protocol
premise: Emergency dispatcher Nessa Ward hears a missing colleague's voice on a line disconnected years ago, minutes before a citywide blackout. Every restored recording points to another engineered disaster and a private contractor embedded in public services. Across three escalating investigations, Nessa and a disgraced grid engineer race to expose the network before it makes their city uninhabitable.
cover_prompt: Cinematic urban thriller art: an abandoned emergency dispatch console glowing red in the foreground, rain-streaked glass overlooking a blacked-out city with one lit transmission tower. Near-black charcoal, electric red and icy cyan palette; hard graphic contrast and a diagonal severed cable. Uncluttered upper third for bold integrated title lettering.

title: The Buttonhole Detectives
premise: Retired costume maker Celia Finch opens a repair cafe in a market town, only to find a stolen locket sewn into a mayoral candidate's coat after its owner is murdered. With a methodical bicycle mechanic and an indiscreet terrier, she solves a fresh fairground, theatre or village-fete mystery each book while tracing the disappearance that first divided their community.
cover_prompt: Charming detailed illustrated cozy mystery art: a cheerful repair-cafe window with spools, a vintage sewing machine, a gold locket and a curious terrier; quaint market square beyond, no people or violence. Butter yellow, duck-egg blue and raspberry palette, inviting hand-painted texture and generous upper space for readable integrated title lettering.

title: The Embassy of Distant Suns
premise: Human interpreter Suri Anwar joins a mobile embassy tasked with reopening contact with isolated star systems after a century of silence. Each mission forces her crew to negotiate with a society transformed by a different failed technology. Across four books, recurring signals reveal that the collapse was deliberate, and peace may depend on translating the intentions of its still-active architect.
cover_prompt: Elegant science-fiction concept art: a small crescent-shaped diplomatic ship approaches a colossal translucent orbital meeting ring above a violet planet, three distant suns reflected in its surface. Deep ultramarine, ultraviolet and pearl-white palette, precise architectural forms, immense scale and hopeful wonder. Dark open upper third for the integrated title.

title: The Rooms Beneath the Tide
premise: Coastal building inspector Ruth Sayer discovers occupied rooms beneath houses condemned to the sea, each inhabited by someone the town insists never existed. Every spring tide opens another address and erases a living resident. Over three books, Ruth follows a drowned housing scheme along the coast, fighting an entity that offers the bereaved a reunion in exchange for a stranger's place in the world.
cover_prompt: Atmospheric restrained horror art: a cross-section of a crumbling coastal house, a warmly lit furnished room impossibly intact beneath dark tidal water, a single human shadow behind its curtains. Sea-black, desaturated teal and sickly amber palette, damp tactile realism and disturbing architectural perspective. Negative space in the storm sky for integrated title lettering. No gore.

title: The Indigo Dispatches
premise: In 1890s Bombay, widowed printer Leela Desai accepts an order for railway timetables and uncovers letters hidden inside the proofs. Keeping her press independent draws her into the lives of dockworkers, reformers and a railway clerk with divided loyalties. Three books follow the expanding print shop through censorship, labour unrest and family reckonings, as Leela decides whose stories deserve the risk of publication.
cover_prompt: Rich historical fiction illustration: an 1890s Indian woman in an indigo sari standing at a hand-operated printing press, scattered blank proofs in the foreground, Bombay railway arches and a steam locomotive framed through a tall window. Indigo ink, aged ivory and burnt sienna palette; engraved textures and warm dusty sunlight. Clear upper space for an elegant integrated title.

title: The Rooftop Frequency
premise: Sixteen-year-old sound enthusiast Eden Park discovers that her homemade rooftop radio picks up broadcasts from the next school year. With two classmates she barely trusts, she starts changing small disasters, then hears their neighbourhood scheduled for demolition. Across three school years, the friends investigate who is transmitting while learning that protecting a shared future means letting one another choose it.
cover_prompt: Vibrant YA speculative illustration: three teenage silhouettes gathered around a homemade antenna on an apartment rooftop, looping luminous radio waves above a dense friendly neighbourhood, a bicycle and headphones nearby. Electric violet, tangerine and turquoise palette, energetic screen-print textures and hopeful twilight. Uncluttered sky for expressive integrated title lettering.

title: A Table for the Departed
premise: In 1920s Marseille, community cook Amira Haddad inherits her late father's notebook of meals promised to people he never spoke of. Her monthly dinners draw dockworkers, estranged relatives and displaced neighbours to one table. A literary family trilogy follows the household through the Depression and wartime occupation, each gathering revising what they believe about loyalty, migration and the cost of belonging.
cover_prompt: Sophisticated historical literary fiction still-life illustration: a 1920s Marseille dining table seen from above with mismatched ceramic plates, an old recipe notebook without incidental legible marks, sliced citrus, a vintage oil lamp and one empty bentwood chair casting a long shadow. Muted terracotta, olive, cream and ink-blue palette, tactile paper collage and quiet emotional restraint. Generous clean upper space for a refined integrated title.

title: The Glasshouse Evidence
premise: Forensic botanist Kit Mercer identifies a rare seed on the coat of a man found dead inside a sealed municipal glasshouse. Hired as an independent consultant, Kit pairs with a meticulous detective to solve cases linked by plants, traded specimens and carefully staged environments. Over four books, each closed case exposes another theft from the vanished research collection that ended Kit's academic career.
cover_prompt: Stylish investigative mystery art: a Victorian municipal glasshouse at blue hour, one shattered pane, a rare crimson flower in a specimen jar sharply focused in front, branching shadows resembling a clue diagram. Bottle green, midnight blue and restrained crimson palette, crisp fine detail and atmospheric mist. Dark open upper third for the integrated title. No bodies.
